title: Dominating a proper modification by blowups in closed points over a finite set of regular surface points
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a proper morphism which is an isomorphism outside a finite set of closed points with regular local rings of dimension two is dominated by a sequence of blowups in closed points above that set (statement lines 1145-1158). The proof (proof lines 1159-1179) reduces to an admissible blowing up, principalizes its ideal, and applies the universal property of blowing up. H2: a complete three step reduction.
